item.title: About me
item.description: I am a first-year master’s student in Computer Science and Technology at ShanghaiTech University, advised by Prof. Ziping Zhao. I began my graduate studies in September 2026. My research interests are in optimization, particularly optimization on probability spaces and over probability distributions, and statistics. I am drawn to the mathematical foundations of these areas and the connections between them. Previously, I completed my undergraduate studies at Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications (BUPT).

item.title: News
item.description: I hope this page will be a place where I can share my life and work. I will update it regularly with my latest news and updates. Just keep going! September 09 2026 | I officially began my graduate studies at ShanghaiTech University. I look forward to learning, exploring new ideas, and making meaningful research progress. June 01 2026 | Tuned in to the OT+OPT Workshop online! Gained a lot of inspiring insights into the latest research in optimization and optimal transport.

item.title: Research interests
item.description: My current research focuses on optimization for time series models. I am also interested in exploring optimization on probability spaces and over probability distributions. Optimization & Optimization I am currently studying optimization for autoregressive moving-average (ARMA) and time-varying parameter (TVP) models. Optimization on probability spaces and distributions This is a direction I would like to explore in the future; I have not yet begun research in this area.
